about: Grammar corrections Amal made that fit no existing rule. Each is a proposed new rule for Medi's yes or no; nothing here is scored until he says yes. Built by scripts/full_audit_build.py from the audit rows and data/lesson-work/full-audit/proposed-buckets.json.

proposals.name: pronoun matches who you mean
proposals.proposed_rule: Pick the pronoun for the real person: humma for 'they' (his family), heyye for 'she' (his fiancee), not the last pronoun used.
proposals.from: 09-24 sweep group NEW-A12 (proposed then, never shown to Medi)

proposals.name: noun, not verb, after a preposition
proposals.proposed_rule: After bi / fi / min use the noun of the action, not a verb: ana ma3roof bi el-tabe5 (her chat 09-21), not bi a6bo5.
proposals.from: 09-24 sweep group NEW-C11 (proposed then, never shown to Medi)

proposals.name: a doing verb says what was done
proposals.proposed_rule: A verb like 3amal (do / make) names what was done: 3amalna tamreen kteer, not just 3amalna kteer (Amal kept asking 'shu 3amalna?' until he added it).

proposals.proposed_rule: To make / let someone become X use a5alli + object ending + bare verb (a5alliha t9eer), not laazem + verb.

moments.medi_said: make her a good [speaking Arabic] Would it be [speaking Arabic] ?
moments.amal_said: Let her be. ... أخليها تصير ... أنا لازم تصير؟ No. You'd need something like to make her، to make to let her become.
moments.chat: bas ana ra7 ajrreb a5alliha t9eer muwazzafe mnee7a
moments.why: Amal echoed his form 'أنا لازم تصير؟' and said No, then gave a5alliha t9eer; low because he offered it as 'would it be ...?' and his Arabic is hidden by the engine.

proposals.proposed_rule: For weather use ONE subject, الدنيا (feminine verb/adjective) or الجو (masculine), never both together: الدنيا بردت / الجو برد

moments.amal_said: No, no, no. Either دنيا or جو. One just one.
moments.why: He stacked both weather words; Amal: either دنيا or جو, just one.

proposals.proposed_rule: After asking / telling someone to do something (talabet min ...) the action is a bare present verb even in a past story, never the past: talabet min el-muwazzaf yiji, not aja.

moments.amal_said: To come. So it's not to came. So it's to come.
moments.chat: talabet min el-muwazzaf illi yiji u ynaddef el-8urfe
moments.why: After asking someone to do something the action is a bare present verb, not past; she said it's to come not came and he said يجي. No bucket covers tense after a request verb (B2 is about the b-, not past vs present).

proposals.proposed_rule: awal / aa5er / taani before a noun never take el-: awal sayyaara = the first car; after the noun they are adjectives and take el-: el-usboo3 el-awal.

moments.medi_said: Il awal il tamreen or il tamreen il awal is the first exercise.
moments.right: awal tamreen / il tamreen il awal
moments.why: Amal's rule this lesson: awal before the noun never takes el- (il awal il tamreen is not a form); she let it pass.

proposals.proposed_rule: nafs (same) is followed by an el- noun: nafs el-ishi = the same thing; nafs ishi is not a phrase.

moments.amal_said: Nafs al ishi. ... نفس الـ إشي the same thing. نفس إشي doesn't mean anything.
moments.why: Amal recast نفس الـ إشي and said نفس إشي means nothing.

proposals.proposed_rule: Before the noun, awal / tani / aa5er / 8eir take no el- (awal sa3a, tani yoam, 8eir yoam); 'the first X' puts the ordinal AFTER as an adjective with el- on both (el-saa3a el-oowla) - el-awal el-saa3a / tani el-saa3a mean nothing

moments.medi_said: and التاني الساعة means a different hour.
moments.amal_said: لا. We can't say تاني الساعة. It doesn't mean anything.
moments.chat: taani saa3a = second hour / second hour
moments.why: He put el-tani before el-saa3a; she said it means nothing.

proposals.proposed_rule: Tool words awal / aa5er / tani / 8eir: right BEFORE a noun they take the bare noun with no el- (tani 7ada = second person, 8eir yoam = another day, aa5er muwazzafe = the last employee); awal el- / aa5er el- + noun means beginning / end of; AFTER the noun they act as adjectives (7ada taani = someone else)

moments.amal_said: تاني حدا would mean the second person.
moments.why: Engine wrote حاجة; Amal echoes تاني حدا - before the noun tani means 'second', for 'someone else' it goes after: 7ada taani.

proposals.proposed_rule: آخر (like أول) before an el- noun means 'the end of'; for 'the last X' use آخر + bare noun (آخر موظفة) or X el-a5eera.

moments.medi_said: مين آخر الـ ... آخر Moazafa, right?
moments.chat: min aa5er muwazzafe/a / min el-muwazzafa el-a5ira
moments.why: آخر + el-noun means 'the end of'; Amal asked 'The end of the employees?' and he dropped el-: مين آخر موظفة?, which she accepted (Mm-hmm).

proposals.name: awal / oola: before or after the noun
proposals.proposed_rule: awal + noun = first; awal + el- + noun = the beginning of; after the noun: el-noun el-awal / el-oola (matches gender)
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
proposals.pattern: awal + noun = first  |  awal + el- + noun = the beginning of  |  el- + noun + el-awal / el-oola = the first
bullets: awal sa3a = first hour / the first hour. No el- in front of awal when it comes first.
awal el-sa3a = the beginning of the hour. The el- on the noun changes the meaning.
After the noun it is an adjective and matches the gender: el-saa3a el-oola, el-yoam el-awal.

examples.line: awal sa3a - the first hour
awal el-sa3a - the beginning of the hour
haadi awal sa3a fi shu8lna / haadi el-saa3a el-oowla fi shu8ulna - this is the first hour in our work
awal el-sa3a = the beginning of the hour
اليوم الأول - the first day (أول اليوم = the beginning of the day)

proposals.name: taani: before or after the noun
proposals.proposed_rule: taani + noun = second; noun + taani = another / the second; el-noun el-taani / el-tanye; taani never takes el- in front
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
proposals.pattern: taani + noun = second  |  noun + taani = another / second  |  el- + noun + el-taani = the second
bullets: taani yoam = second day / the second day. yoam taani = another day (or the second).
taani el-... means nothing: there is no 'beginning of' meaning like awal el-.
Feminine after the noun: el-marra el-tanye = the second time; marra tanye = another time.

examples.line: taani = second/else/other
We can't say تاني الساعة. It doesn't mean anything.
taani saa3a = second hour / the second hour
el-masari ra7 yiju fi tani youm / youm tani - the money will come on the second day / another day
hadi tani marra ana bashufek el-yoam / hadi el-marra el-tania illi bashufek elyoam - this is the second time I see you today
bashufak marra tanye = i'll see you another time

proposals.name: aa5er / a5eer: before or after the noun
proposals.proposed_rule: aa5er + noun = last; aa5er + el- + noun = the end of; after the noun the adjective a5eer / a5eera / a5eeraat
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
proposals.pattern: aa5er + noun = last  |  aa5er + el- + noun = the end of  |  el- + noun + el-a5eer / el-a5eera = the last
bullets: aa5er marra = last time / the last time. aa5er el-marra = the end of the turn.
After the noun use a5eer (m) / a5eera (f) / a5eeraat (plural): el-marra el-a5eera.
aa5er el-ijtima3 = the end of the meeting.

examples.line: The آخر as an adjective is أخير or أخيرة - last or final
a5eer/a = last/final (adjective)
aa5er marra = last time / the last time
el-marra el-a5eera = the last time
aa5er el-ijtima3 = the end of the meeting
aa5er 3ashar da2aaye2 / el-3ashar da2aaye2 el-a5eeraat - the last ten minutes

proposals.name: 8eir: other / different, no el-
proposals.proposed_rule: 8eir + noun = other / different; 8eir never takes el- in front; after the noun is rare
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
bullets: 8eir yoam = another day. 8eir akle = a different dish.
Only one meaning (other / different), so there is no el- version to learn.
After the noun (el-yoam el-8eir) is rare; 8eir yoam is far more common.

examples.line: 8eir = other/different
غير يوم is way, way, way more common
bashufek 8eir yoam = i'll see you another day
e7na bidna 8eir akle - we want a different dish
37na 3indna 8eir dyoof kul yoam - we have different guests every day

proposals.name: nafs + el-: the same
proposals.proposed_rule: nafs + el- + noun = the same ...; never el- before nafs; nafs is never an adjective after the noun
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
bullets: nafs = the same. The noun after it always has el-.
Never el- before nafs: el-nafs el-... is wrong.
nafs is only a tool word, never an adjective after the noun.

examples.line: نفس ... it takes ال. نفس الـ issue
the rule is نفس always takes ال after, but it never takes ال before
haad nafs el-ishi - this is the same thing
ana basoo2 nafs el-taree2 kul yom - I drive the same route every day

proposals.name: kul: all vs every (add el-kull = everyone)
proposals.proposed_rule: kul + noun = every; kul + el- + noun = all / the whole; el-kull = everyone (new line for A11)
proposals.from: 2026-10-02 lesson (Amal taught the tool words before / after a noun); Medi 2026-10-05: 'build a proposal on these on how to write them in our grammar rules and send them for review with letter number categories for Amal'
proposals.pattern: kul + noun = every  |  kul + el- + noun = all / the whole  |  el-kull = everyone
bullets: kul el-yoam = all day / the whole day.

examples.line: كل is every, and then كل ال is like all
kul + noun = every
kul + el = all / the whole
el-kull = everyone
